title: Fixed image-based PSX announcement source previews
points: Failure case: image-only PSX announcements, including GIF/image notices, could appear in answers without a useful source-panel thumbnail or stable hosted preview.

Source logic fixed: announcement source links now prefer hosted `source.psxgpt.com/ANNOUNCEMENTS/...` assets, and the publisher scans local `announcement_documents/` files so image notices are not skipped when a generated JSONL scope is narrower than D1.
Shipped result: image-based announcements now open with a hosted source asset and preview in the source panel instead of falling back to direct PSX URLs without thumbnails.
